title: Annealed Ruelle-Pollicott Resonances
summary: We adapt the theory of Ruelle-Pollicott resonances to annealed random dynamical systems generated by independent and identically distributed families of maps. Introducing annealed transfer and Koopman operators, we define resonances as elements of the point spectrum of the associated operators and establish a decorrelation formula relating these resonances to the asymptotic decay of annealed correlations.
